arguments.message: Reese planning proposal: prioritize all STRICT meetings at full windows: m001 [1,2), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12). To avoid overlap penalties, my tentative soft plan is a single-chain similar to Reese's: early block choose one of {m002 [0,1) or m003 [0,1)} then m006 [2,3), m015 [4,5), m009 [7,9), and late choose one of {m005 [12,14) or m007 [11,13)}. I also like m012 [3,4) if people prefer that instead of m006, but not both due overlap. Since m009 overlaps stricts if extended past 9, I'd cap it at [7,9). Please share which exact slots you can match, especially for m002 vs m003, m006 vs m012, and m005 vs m007.
